subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

Russia brandishes the threat of a gas cutoff to squeeze Kiev and **__coerce__** Europe.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"coerce"** means to force someone to do something by using threats or violence. (बलपूर्वक कराना)

 
 
• **Example: **The criminal tried to** coerce** the witness into lying in court.
 
 
 
• **"Assist" **refers to helping or giving support to someone. (मदद करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher **assisted** the student with his homework.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'coerce' **is **'assist'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Intimidate **(धमकाना): To frighten or overawe someone, especially in order to make them do what one wants.

 
 
• **Example:** The gang tried to intimidate the shopkeeper into paying protection money.
 
 
 
• **Force **(बल): To make someone do something against their will.
 
 
• **Example: **The police had to use force to break up the protest.
 
 
 
• **Bully** (धौंस जमाना): To seek to harm, intimidate, or coerce someone perceived as vulnerable.
 
 
• **Example:** The school is taking steps to reduce bullying among students.
